description: Shared copier-manager policy: the template-trust switch plus the standards template re-render rule. Composed by default.json, and extended directly by centrally dispatched repos such as mac-dev-playbook that need bespoke repo-owned Renovate configuration rather than the org preset's defaults — so both config paths inherit ONE definition instead of copying the rule. Deliberately contains nothing but copier-scoped config: the packageRule is pinned to matchManagers:["copier"], so extending this preset cannot alter any other manager's behaviour. `copier.ignoreScripts:false` is the trusted-template half of the re-render trust switch — Renovate's copier manager appends `--trust` to `copier update` ONLY when GlobalConfig.allowScripts is true AND !ignoreScripts (see renovate lib/modules/manager/copier/artifacts.ts). `allowScripts` is self-hosted/global-only and lives in the runner's config; `ignoreScripts` defaults to true, so it MUST be flipped to false here to let the standards template's _tasks (post-render scripts) and _migrations run. It is scoped to the copier manager on purpose so npm/composer/bun install-scripts stay ignored everywhere else.

packageRules.description: The standards Copier template re-render, tracked by Renovate's native copier manager. Reads `_commit`/`_src_path` from each consumer's `.copier-answers.yml` and ships a full `copier update` re-render PR. The versioning regex isolates `template/vX.Y.Z` tags and preserves the full tag as the written ref; its optional prerelease group also parses git-describe current values. Requires a full https `_src_path` so the git-tags datasource can discover versions (Copier's `gh:` shorthand does not work there). First-party promoted tags skip the global supply-chain soak. This copier-only rule enables GitHub-native auto-merge after the independent audit App approves the eligible PR; GitHub still waits for required checks and rulesets. Other Renovate updates retain their existing merge policies. High PR priority gives re-renders a slot during standards channel promotions.
